name: update_topic_progress
description: Compatibility progress tool. In authoritative graph-memory courses this is READ-ONLY: no arguments can set concept mastery, clear misconceptions, mark transfer success or cross thresholds. The authenticated route durably captures learner input and server assessment submissions independently; a deterministic versioned policy publishes state. Read get_threshold_concepts for the actual committed verdict and pending/freshness information. Never fabricate evidence from your own explanation or claim a state change because this tool returned. For legacy courses only, topic/status/summary update the old display progress; learned there is not a verified graph crossing. Diagnostic labels and mappings remain private.

topic.description: The topic name to update progress for.

status.description: Legacy display hint only. For authoritative graph-memory courses this tool cannot change state, clear a misconception, or cross a threshold; the durable evidence processor owns those decisions.

summary.description: A brief description of what the student understands about this topic right now.

threshold_concept.description: The exact threshold-concept name from get_threshold_concepts. Supply this when recording concept-inventory outcomes so progress and misconceptions attach to the right concept instead of being fuzzy-matched from the topic name.

misconceptions_addressed.description: Misconceptions from this threshold concept's misconception bank that the student has now resolved. Leave empty unless you have direct evidence. This is teacher-only metadata: never name a misconception in student-visible text.

misconception.description: The exact misconception text from the threshold concept's misconception bank returned by get_threshold_concepts.

note.description: 1-2 sentences recording the evidence that the student no longer holds this misconception — quote or paraphrase what they actually said or answered.
